chunks: From him, from Ahmad, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who feeds three persons from the Muslims, Allah would Feed him from three Gardens in the kingdom of the skies – Al-Firdows, and the Garden of Eden, and Tooba, and it is a tree coming out from the Garden of Eden. Our Lord Planted it with His own Hands'.

key_terms.طُوبَى: Tooba (a tree or garden in Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for feeding three Muslims according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith to emphasize the spiritual weight of sustaining three believers, linking the act directly to the highest tiers of Paradise. The mention of 'Tooba' and the tree planted by God’s Hand reflects Shia exegetical tradition where these symbols represent the progeny of the Prophet and divine favor, elevating simple charity to a cosmic reward.
